assessments.label: strong

assessments.caveat: Requires Sai, Master Thopterist to survive and enough expendable artifacts.

assessments.label: strong
assessments.reason: Turns the deck's many artifact casts into reliable card draw while also triggering Alela, Artful Provocateur.
assessments.caveat: Four mana and double blue compete with other card engines.

assessments.label: strong
assessments.reason: A cheap artifact creature that reduces the cost of the deck's numerous artifact spells and triggers Alela, Artful Provocateur.
assessments.caveat: Redundant with Foundry Inspector and vulnerable as a creature.

assessments.label: worth_testing
assessments.reason: Draws from enchantment casts and triggers Alela, Artful Provocateur, but the deck has substantially more artifacts than enchantments.
assessments.caveat: Requires replacing a card and retaining enough enchantments to justify the creature.

assessments.reason: Green color identity is outside Alela, Artful Provocateur's white-blue-black color identity.

assessments.label: worth_testing
assessments.reason: A large flying threat can become cheaper as Alela, Artful Provocateur's Faeries and other flyers accumulate, but it provides no artifact-cast trigger or card advantage.
assessments.caveat: Its nine-mana base cost makes it dependent on already having a substantial flying board.

assessments.label: reject
assessments.reason: Its creature removal is narrow and its alternative is only modest card advantage, with no artifact or Faerie synergy.

assessments.label: reject
assessments.reason: Provides only a small combat buff and has no artifact-cast, token, or card-advantage role.

assessments.label: reject
assessments.reason: Life gain from Alela, Artful Provocateur does not compensate for this low-impact creature's lack of artifact or token synergy.

assessments.label: worth_testing
assessments.reason: Every artifact entering draws a card while also triggering Alela, Artful Provocateur, offering a strong engine in this artifact-dense deck.
assessments.caveat: Five mana is expensive and it requires an artifact-heavy replacement package to be worthwhile.

assessments.label: reject
assessments.reason: Creature-only removal that gives a card when the target was not attacking is redundant with the deck's broader removal.

assessments.label: worth_testing
assessments.reason: A flying creature that scries whenever other creatures die can benefit from board wipes and token trades, though it does not advance the artifact engine directly.
assessments.caveat: Its trigger is reactive and offers selection rather than cards or board development.

assessments.label: worth_testing
assessments.reason: An artifact cast triggers Alela, Artful Provocateur, and equipping it to Alela can double Alela's triggered ability.
assessments.caveat: Alela cannot use Equip Wizard, so the generic three-mana equip cost is required; the card needs a supporting swap for a lower-impact artifact.
required_changes: Replace a lower-impact artifact or equipment with Wizard's Staff.
